verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents issuing API tokens or credentials with restricted permission scopes. The only related item (sentry-docs-46) describes the MCP server constraining its tools to an org/project and hiding discovery tools. That is an adjacent tool-scoping behavior, not least-privilege credential issuance. The API docs mention programmatic access but say nothing about scoped tokens.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
